common.promptStandard: Purpose: authored wall-mounted company clocks with host-driven absolute time display. Specification: analog clocks use a 0.35m x 0.35m x 0.08m envelope, digital clocks use a 0.50m x 0.18m x 0.06m envelope. Units are metres, up is +Y, forward is +Z, wall contact is the centered origin, back is z=0 and front is +Z. Installation and load bearing: wall-mounted static decor with no use points and no scaling. Budget: deterministic CPU-only primitive geometry, no textures, no animation, no external art and at most 100 meshes, 15000 triangles, 8 materials and 1MiB per GLB. State: host clockSeconds plus saved display settings only, no internal clock or timer. Source/export: project-authored Three.js 0.187.0 parameters, GLTFExporter and GLTFLoader readback.
